data.name: Dhruti
data.gender_notes: Dhruti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhru’ which means ‘that which is firm, steady, or enduring’. In Hindu mythology, Dhruti represents the goddess of patience, endurance, and fortitude. She is often depicted as the wife of Bhagiratha, the king who prayed to bring the god Ganga to earth. The name Dhruti carries the meaning “Firm, steady, support” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhruti usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, steady, support and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Dhruti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, steady, support.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhruti total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
